definition: done or worn as it was long ago
description: Outside a wooden mountain hut, a young man in an embroidered folk shirt, leather belt and a black felt hat with a feather cooks an old country dish over a fire. He scrapes small dumplings off a wooden board into a big black cauldron of boiling water, holds up a white lump of sheep cheese, sprinkles fried bacon over the pot and stirs it with a wooden spoon. He then serves the finished dish in a carved wooden bowl on a rough wooden table and grins at the camera while hikers watch from the hut behind him.
